ATCSCC ADVZY 046 DCC/ZBW 05/14/2026 NATOTS_RQD
RAW TEXT:
EVENT TIME: 14/2100 - 15/0500 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZBW NORTH ATLANTIC ADVISORY ALL AIRCRAFT TRANSITING THROUGH BOSTON-MONCTON OR MONTREAL-MONCTON AIRSPACE WITH THE INTENTION OF JOINING THE NORTH ATLANTIC TRACK ORGANIZED TRACK STRUCTURE (NAT OTS) MUST FILE THEIR ROUTING VIA THE NARS ASSIGNED TO THE OCEAN ENTRY POINT THAT CORRESPONDS WITH THEIR INTENDED NAT TRACK. THESE NAR ASSIGNMENTS FOR THE NAT TRACKS ONLY ARE PUBLISHED BY NAV CANADA. NAT OPERATORS SHOULD REFER TO NAT OPS BULLETIN 2023-001 REV 4. SUBMIT ONLY ONE RCL TO CZQX 90-60 MINS PRIOR TO OEP. PLANNED OCEANIC ALT/RTE/SPD MAY DIFFER FROM RCL. DO NOT CHANGE ALTITUDE WITHOUT AN ATC CLEARANCE. OCEANIC CLEARANCE NO LONGER REQUIRED IN EASTBOUND NAT AIRSPACE. AS PER NOTAM, TALGO & BOBTU ARE UNAVAILABLE. EASTBOUND NAT FLIGHTS ENTERING OR EXITING KZWY VIA CZQM SHOULD FILE VIA NOVOK OR JEBBY. DEPARTURE TRACKS VIA HAPIE ARE NOT AUTHORIZED WHEN W105 IS SCHEDULED OR ACTIVE. ATCSCC ADVZY 072 DCC/ZMP 05/14/2026 ZMP SWAP_FYI
MESSAGE:
EVENT TIME: 14/1815 - 15/0200 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZMP THIS ADVISORY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. CUSTOMERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO COMPLY WITH ALL ATCSCC ROUTE ADVISORIES AND TO FILE USING TOS. ZMP SWAP STATEMENT: SEVERE WEATHER AVOIDANCE PLANS ARE EXPECTED FOR ZMP AIRSPACE AFTER 1800z. EXPECTED IMPACT AREA:) WEST OF MSP FROM SUX TO THE CANADIAN BORDER WITH SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS AFFECTING DEPARTURES AND ARRIVALS THROUGH THOSE AREAS. PLANNED ALTERNATIVE DEPARTURE ROUTES: CUSTOMERS CAN EXPECT REROUTES AND/OR DEPARTURE DELAYS. IF NO ATCSCC ROUTE ADVISORIES ARE IN EFFECT, CUSTOMERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO FILE PUBLISHED CDR's AROUND KNOWN FORECAST WEATHER. PLANNED ALTERNATIVE ARRIVAL ROUTES: CUSTOMERS CAN EXPECT POSSIBLE PLAYBOOKS, TACTICAL ROUTE ADJUSTMENTS, AND HOLDING ON INBOUND FLIGHTS, DUE TO CONVECTIVE WEATHER IMPACTS TO AIRSPACE SURROUNDING THE MSP TERMINAL AREA. FUEL ADVISORY: PLEASE FUEL ACCORDINGLY FOR POSSIBLE DEPARTURE GATE CHANGES, PLAYBOOKS, TACTICAL REROUTES, HOLDING, AND OTHER TMI's DUE TO AIRSPACE BEING CONSTRICTED OR AFFECTED BY CONVECTIVE WEATHER.
EFFECTIVE TIME:
141851-150230
SIGNATURE:
26/05/14 18:51

ATCSCC ADVZY 004 DCC/ZMP 05/16/2026 ZMP SWAP FYI
MESSAGE:
EVENT TIME: 16/0015 - 16/0600 THIS ADVISORY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. CUSTOMERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO COMPLY WITH ALL ATCSCC ROUTE ADVISORIES AND TO FILE USING TOS. ZMP SWAP STATEMENT: SEVERE WEATHER AVOIDANCE PLANS ARE EXPECTED FOR ZMP AIRSPACE AFTER XXXXz. EXPECTED IMPACT AREA: 0015-0600z, SOUTHERN MN, CENTRAL IOWA PLANNED ALTERNATIVE DEPARTURE ROUTES: CUSTOMERS CAN EXPECT REROUTES AND/OR DEPARTURE DELAYS. IF NO ATCSCC ROUTE ADVISORIES ARE IN EFFECT, CUSTOMERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO FILE PUBLISHED CDR's AROUND KNOWN FORECAST WEATHER. PLANNED ALTERNATIVE ARRIVAL ROUTES: CUSTOMERS CAN EXPECT POSSIBLE PLAYBOOKS, TACTICAL ROUTE ADJUSTMENTS, AND HOLDING ON INBOUND FLIGHTS, DUE TO CONVECTIVE WEATHER IMPACTS TO AIRSPACE SURROUNDING THE MSP TERMINAL AREA. FUEL ADVISORY: PLEASE FUEL ACCORDINGLY FOR POSSIBLE DEPARTURE GATE CHANGES, PLAYBOOKS, TACTICAL REROUTES, HOLDING, AND OTHER TMI's DUE TO AIRSPACE BEING CONSTRICTED OR AFFECTED BY CONVECTIVE WEATHER.
EFFECTIVE TIME:
160018-160630
SIGNATURE:
26/05/16 00:18

ATCSCC ADVZY 026 DCC/ZAU 05/16/2026 ZAU SWAP_FYI
RAW TEXT:
EVENT TIME: 16/1200 - 16/2300 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZAU THIS ADVISORY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. CUSTOMERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO COMPLY WITH ALL ATCSCC ROUTE ADVISORIES. ZAU SWAP STATEMENT: SEVERE WEATHER AVOIDANCE PLANS ARE EXPECTED FOR THE SOUTHERN PORTION OF ZAU AIRSPACE THIS MORNING ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN ILLINOIS AND INDIANA AFTER 1200Z. EXPECTED IMPACT AREA: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO IMPACT CHICAGO METRO SOUTHBOUND DEPARTURES UTILIZING THE C-D-E TRACKS. PLANNED ALTERNATE DEPARTURE ROUTES: DEPARTURES LANDING INTERNAL ZAU AIRPORTS SOUTH OF ORD/MDW MAY FILE NORMAL ROUTES BUT ARE ENCOURAGED TO FUEL FOR POSSIBLE TACTICAL REROUTES. SOUTHBOUND DEPARTURE ROUTES VIA C-D-E TRACKS ARE ANTICIPATED TO BE IMPACTED CAUSING CODED DEPARTURE ROUTES (CDR'S) AND/OR SWAPS. DEPARTURES TO ZID, ZTL/FLORIDA AND TOBACCO ROAD ARE ENCOURAGED TO UTILIZE CDR EASTBOUND VIA THE 2E CDR OR UTILIZE CDR'S VIA BACEN IN THE B TRACK. POSSIBLE DELAYS AND MIT MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH THIS INITIATIVE AND MAY CAUSE LONGER THAN NORMAL DEPARTURE WAIT TIMES. PLEASE FUEL ACCORDINGLY. FUEL ADVISORY: PLEASE FUEL ACCORDINGLY FOR POSSIBLE CDR'S, PLAYBOOKS, TACTICAL REROUTES AND OTHER TMI'S DUE TO AIRSPACE BEING AFFECTED BY CONVECTIVE WEATHER. PLEASE CONTACT ZAU TMU AT (630) 906-8241 WITH ANY QUESTIONS. 161142-162300 26/05/16 11:42 DCCOPS.lxstn32

ATCSCC ADVZY 039 DCC/ZDC 05/16/2026 ZDC SWAP_FYI
RAW TEXT:
EVENT TIME: 16/1411 - 17/0000 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZDC THIS ADVISORY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. CUSTOMERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO FILE NFDC PREFERRED ROUTES. SWAP STATEMENT: ***ZDC CWSU SWAP STATEMENT - 16/1328Z*** SWAP IS POSSIBLE FOR THE ZDC AIRSPACE AFTER 20Z. ISOLATED TS TO DEVELOP AFTER 20Z WEST OF THE DC METROS, LIKELY AFFECTING J6 & AREAS NEAR & NORTH/WEST OF J8 & J48. RESIDUAL LIGHT RAIN & SHOWERS (TOPS FL200 - 300) MAY REACH THE DC METROS AFTER 00Z. TS TOPS FL250 - 350, MOVING EAST 20 KTS. PLANNED ALTERNATE DEPARTURE ROUTES: CDRS FOR OTTTO/RAMAY MAY BE UTILIZED AS ROUTES ARE IMPACTED. MINIMAL IMPACTS TO J6 / PARKE POSSIBLE WITH LATER DEVELOPMENT OF ISOLATED TS. COMPRESSION OF FLOWS SOUTH OF THE AREAS OF TS MAY CAUSE SUBSEQUENT FLOWS TO SHIFT (GATE SWAPS) TO ACCOMODATE ADDITIONAL VOLUME IN ZDC FROM ZOB AND ZID. TRAJECTORY OPTION SET (TOS) GUIDANCE: OPERATORS SHOULD CONSIDER TOS OPTIONS VIA THESE CDR SUFFIX CODES AS THE ORIGINAL ROUTES BECOME IMPACTED. DO NOT FILE ACTUAL FLIGHT PLANS WITH THESE CDRS. COORDINATION IS REQUIRED. AVAILABLE CDRS IN ORDER OF ZDC PREFERENCE: IMPACTED: RAMAY/J149/Q72 AVAILABLE CDR: 78/60/55/11 IMPACTED: OTTTO/Q68/Q80/Q176 AVAILABLE CDR: 65/55/78 PLANNED ALTERNATE ARRIVAL ROUTES: FLIGHTS INTO THE DC METROS VIA RAVNN/TRUPS/GIBBZ ARRIVALS MAY BE IMPACTED AND SWAPPED TO ALTERNATE ARRIVAL FIXES. OVERFLIGHTS: AIRCRAFT OVERFLYING ZDC VIA J6 MAY BE IMPACTED ALONG THEIR ROUTE OF FLIGHT AFTER 2000Z. FUEL ADVISORY: LIMBO RTES/AIRCRAFT CAPPING AT OR BELOW 100 POSSIBLE FOR DESTINATIONS OUT TO 100 MILES FROM THE DEPARTURE POINT AND MAY INCLUDE POSSIBLE CAPPING PLAYBOOKS. HOTLINE ACTIVATION: POSSIBLE AFTER 1800Z. (540) 359-3200 PIN: 2779 161414-170030 26/05/16 14:14 DCCOPS.lxstn28

ATCSCC ADVZY 061 DCC 05/16/2026 DEN CAPPING TUNNELING FYI
MESSAGE:
EVENT TIME: 16/2115 - 17/0100 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZDV THIS ADVISORY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. WIDELY SCATTERED SHRA & TSRA AREA EXPECTED TO BUILD AND IMPACT THE DEN TERMINAL AREA. CAPPING PLAN: KDEN DEPARTURES TO THE NORTH / EAST / SOUTH MAY BE CAPPED AOB FL250 FOR APPROXIMATELY 300 MILES DUE TO A LARGE AREA OF THUNDERSTORMS CAUSING VOLUME CONCERNS IN THE HIGH ALTITUDE SECTORS. TUNNELING PLAN: FLIGHTS INTO THE DEN AIRPORT FROM THE EAST MAY BE DESCENDED EARLY DUE TO VOLUME CONCERNS IN THE ZDV HIGH ALTITUDE SECTORS CAUSED BY A LARGE LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS. ADDITIONAL TMI'S MAY BE NECESSARY DUE TO INCREASED VOLUME IN THE LOW ALTITUDE SECTORS. PLEASE ADVISE FLIGHT CREWS TO LIMIT REQUESTS DUE TO INCREASED VOLUME AND COMPLEXITY IN THESE SECTORS. FUEL ADVISORY: USERS SHOULD FUEL ACCORDINGLY.
EFFECTIVE TIME:
162039-170130
SIGNATURE:
26/05/16 20:39

PLANNED ALTERNATE DEPARTURE ROUTES: CDRS FOR DEN DEP GATES WILL BE UTILIZED AS ROUTES ARE IMPACTED. ATCSCC ADVZY 053 DCC 05/17/2026 ZDV CAPPING AND TUNNELING FYI
MESSAGE:
EVENT TIME: 17/1900 - 18/0200 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZDV THIS ADVISORY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. DEN AIRPORT/GATES ESTIMATED IMPACT TIME FRAME : 171930Z TO 180200Z WIDELY SCATTERED SHRA & TSRA AREA EXPECTED TO BUILD AND IMPACT THE DEN TERMINAL AREA. CAPPING PLAN: KDEN DEPARTURES TO THE NORTH / EAST / SOUTH / WEST MAY BE CAPPED AOB FL250 FOR APPROXIMATELY 300 MILES DUE TO A LARGE AREA OF THUNDERSTORMS CAUSING VOLUME CONCERNS IN THE HIGH ALTITUDE SECTORS. TUNNELING PLAN: FLIGHTS INTO THE DEN AIRPORT FROM THE EAST MAY BE DESCENDED EARLY DUE TO VOLUME CONCERNS IN THE ZDV HIGH ALTITUDE SECTORS CAUSED BY A LARGE LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS. ADDITIONAL TMI'S MAY BE NECESSARY DUE TO INCREASED VOLUME IN THE LOW ALTITUDE SECTORS. PLEASE ADVISE FLIGHT CREWS TO LIMIT REQUESTS DUE TO INCREASED VOLUME AND COMPLEXITY IN THESE SECTORS. FUEL ADVISORY: USERS SHOULD FUEL ACCORDINGLY.
EFFECTIVE TIME:
171840-180230
SIGNATURE:
26/05/17 18:40

ATCSCC ADVZY 037 DCC 05/18/2026 OPERATIONS PLAN
RAW TEXT:
EVENT TIME: 18/1200 - AND LATER ____________________________________________________________________ CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY WILL IMPACT THE CENTRAL NAS AND INTO C90 AIRSPACE FOR TODAY AND ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORMS FORECAST FOR THE WEST COAST OF ZMA FOR THIS EVENING. TRANSCONS HAVE BEEN ISSUED ALONG WITH ORD/MDW CDRS. C90/ZAU PLANS ON MANAGING THE WEATHER TACTICALLY AT ORD UNTIL AFTER 1500Z. SWA PLANS ON TACTICALLY METERING THEIR FLEET INTO MDW AND THE GROUND STOP REFERENCE IS NOW ONLY POSSIBLE. C90 ARRIVAL ROUTES ARE EXPECTED THROUGHOUT THE DAY. L453 AND L455 HAVE BEEN CLOSED DUE TO THUNDERSTORMS. EGLIN WATER TEST MILITARY ACTIVITY HAS BEEN CANCELED FOR TODAY. ADDITIONAL TERMINAL INITIATIVES ARE IN THE PLAN FOR DTW FOR THUNDERSTORMS, DEN FOR LOW CEILINGS AND SFO FOR WIND, PROCEDURAL COMPLIANCE AND CONSTRUCTION. THE SPACEX STARSHIP FLT 12 HAS BEEN RESCHEDULED FOR 05/20/26. RAW TEXT:
EVENT TIME: 18/1400 - 19/0200 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZDC THIS ADVISORY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. CUSTOMERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO FILE NFDC PREFERRED ROUTES. ***ZDC CWSU SWAP STATEMENT - 18/1243Z*** SEVERE WEATHER AVOIDANCE PLANS ARE POSSIBLE FOR THE ZDC AIRSPACE. 19Z: ISOLATED TS POSSIBLE NORTH OF J8 & WEST OF A MRB - LDN LINE. 21Z: ISOLATED TS EXPECTED NORTH OF J8 FROM MRB WEST, INCLUDING J6 & Q178. 23Z: ISOLATED TS NORTH OF Q34 & WEST OF J48. TS TO DISSIPATE BY 01 - 02Z. TS TOPS FL300 - 400, MOVING NE 10 - 20 KTS. PLANNED ALTERNATE DEPARTURE ROUTES: CDRS FOR OTTTO/RAMAY/JDUBB/CLTCH/SCOOB/SWANN/PALEO AND AGARD MAY BE UTILIZED AS ROUTES ARE IMPACTED AFTER 1800Z. NY/DC/PHL DEPARTURES MAY BE SWAPPED ALONG J6, J48, Q75 DEPENDING ON CONDITIONS AND BUILDUP LOCATIONS. DC METRO DEPARTURES MAY EXPERIENCE DELAYS DUE TO WEATHER. TRAJECTORY OPTION SET (TOS) GUIDANCE: OPERATORS SHOULD CONSIDER TOS OPTIONS VIA THESE CDR SUFFIX CODES AS THE ORIGINAL ROUTES BECOME IMPACTED. DO NOT FILE ACTUAL FLIGHT PLANS WITH THESE CDRS. COORDINATION IS REQUIRED. AVAILABLE CDRS IN ORDER OF ZDC PREFERENCE IMPACTED: SWANN AVAILABLE CDR: 10/11/20/40 IMPACTED: PALEO/AGARD AVAILABLE CDR: 20/10/11/40 IMPACTED: SCOOB AVAILABLE CDR: 50/55/60/20 IMPACTED: JERES/Q221/J220 AVAILABLE CDR: 11/78/65/20 IMPACTED: JERES/J211 AVAILABLE CDR: 78/10/65/60 IMPACTED: RAMAY/J149/Q72 AVAILABLE CDR: 78/60/55/11 IMPACTED: OTTTO/Q68/Q80/Q176 AVAILABLE CDR: 65/55/78/50 IMPACTED: CLTCH/J48/Q40 AVAILABLE CDR: 60/50/32/40 I PLANNED ALTERNATE ARRIVAL ROUTES: FLIGHTS INTO THE DC METROS VIA RAVNN/TRUPS/CAPPS/GIBBZ/CAVLR ARRIVALS MAY BE IMPACTED AND SWAPPED TO ALTERNATE ARRIVAL FIXES. OVERFLIGHTS: AIRCRAFT OVERFLYING ZDC VIA J6 MAY BE IMPACTED ALONG THEIR ROUTE OF FLIGHT AFTER 1800Z. FUEL ADVISORY: LIMBO RTES/AIRCRAFT CAPPING AT OR BELOW 100 POSSIBLE FOR DESTINATIONS OUT TO 100 MILES FROM THE DEPARTURE POINT AND MAY INCLUDE POSSIBLE CAPPING PLAYBOOKS. AIRCRAFT DESTINED KJAX AND NORTH MAY BE CAPPED AOBFL200 DUE TO WEATHER AND VOLUME HOTLINE ACTIVATION: POSSIBLE AFTER 1800Z. (540) 359-3200 PIN: 2779 181312-190200 26/05/18 13:12 DCCOPS.lxstn21

ATCSCC ADVZY 089 STL/ZKC 05/18/2026 STL AIRPORT DIVERSION RECOVERY EXTENDED
MESSAGE:
EVENT TIME: 18/1900 - 19/0200 THIS ADVISORY EXTENDS THE TIMEFRAME FOR ADVISORY 064. THE ATCSCC HAS ACTIVATED THE DIVERSION RECOVERY TOOL FOR STL AIRPORT. CUSTOMERS SHOULD ENSURE THAT DVRSN IS INCLUDED IN FLIGHT PLAN REMARKS OF DIVERTED AIRCRAFT. NOTE THAT IF THERE IS A GROUND DELAY PROGRAM OR GROUND STOP IN EFFECT FOR THE DESTINATION AIRPORT DIVERTED FLIGHTS ARE NOT AUTOMATICALLY EXEMPT AND WILL STILL RECEIVE AN EDCT. UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTIFIED, DIVERSION RECOVERY WILL CLOSE FOR STL AIRPORT AT THE END OF THE EVENT TIME SPECIFIED IN THIS ADVISORY.
EFFECTIVE TIME:
181746-190230
SIGNATURE:

ATCSCC Advisory
ATCSCC ADVZY 137 DCC/ZFW 05/18/2026 ZFW CAPPING/TUNNELING_FYI
MESSAGE:
EVENT TIME: 18/2200 - 19/0300 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZFW AIRCRAFT DEPARTING FROM OR DESTINED FOR DFW/DAL CAN EXPECT TO BE CAPPED OR TUNNELED AT OR BELOW FL230. THIS IS TO REDUCE DEPARTURE DELAYS AND VOLUME INTO THE HIGH ALTITUDE SECTORS AT OR ABOVE FL240 BY CAPITALIZING ON LOW ALTITUDE CAPACITY. PILOTS SHOULD NOT ASK FOR HIGHER ABOVE FL230 TO AVOID FREQUENCY CONGESTION FOR CONTROLLERS. THIS IS DUE TO REDUCED CAPACITY CAUSED BY THUNDERSTORMS IN ZKC AND ZFW.CUSTOMERS SHOULD PLAN ACCORDINGLY FOR FUEL. ANY UPDATES OR CHANGES WILL BE CONVEYED VIA THE ADVISORY SYSTEM.
EFFECTIVE TIME:
182133-190330
SIGNATURE:
26/05/18 21:33

MESSAGE:
EVENT TIME: 19/1200 - 19/2200 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZFW THIS ADVISORY IS FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. CUSTOMERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO FILE NORMAL ROUTINGS BUT EXPECT ALTERNATE DEPARTURE AND ARRIVAL ROUTINGS. SEVERE WEATHER AVOIDANCE PLANS ARE EXPECTED FOR THE ZFW/D10 AREA AFTER 1300Z. POSSIBLE ALTERNATE DEPARTURE ROUTES AND/OR CDRS IMPACTING THE NORTH/WEST GATES. POSSIBLE ALTERNATRE ARRIVAL ROUTES AND/OR PLAYBOOKS IMPACTING THE NORTHEAST/NORTHWEST CORNERS. FUEL ADVISORY : AIRCRAFT CAPPING AT OR BELOW FL230 IS POSSIBLE FOR DEPARTURES UNTIL EXITING ZFW AIRSPACE. NORTH TEXAS WEATHER HOTLINE IS EXPECTED AFTER 1400Z. (540)359-3200 PIN 2244

PLANNED ALTERNATE DEPARTURE ROUTES: NORTHBOUND DEPARTURE ROUTES ARE ANTICIPATED TO BE IMPACTED CAUSING CODED DEPARTURE ROUTES (CDR'S) AND/OR SWAPS. DEPARTURES TO THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST ARE ENCOURAGED TO UTILIZE CDR'S WESTBOUND. DEPARTURES TO THE MIDWEST AND EAST COAST ARE ENCOURAGED TO UTILIZE CDR'S EASTBOUND. DEPARTURES MAY ALSO BE RE-ROUTED TO THE SOUTHWEST AND SOUTHEAST TO MINIMIZE DELAYS AND CONTROL ATC SECTOR VOLUME. POSSIBLE INCREASED DEPARTURE DELAYS AND MIT MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH THIS INITIATIVE AND MAY CAUSE LONGER THAN NORMAL DEPARTURE WAIT TIMES. FUEL ADVISORY: PLEASE FUEL ACCORDINGLY FOR POSSIBLE CDR'S, PLAYBOOKS, TACTICAL REROUTES AND OTHER TMI'S DUE TO AIRSPACE BEING AFFECTED BY CONVECTIVE WEATHER. HOTLINE ACTIVATION: NOT EXPECTED.

ATCSCC ADVZY 087 DCC 05/19/2026 OPERATIONS PLAN
RAW TEXT:
EVENT TIME: 19/2000 - AND LATER ____________________________________________________________________ BOS AND DTW HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THE PLAN FOR POSSIBLE TERMINAL INITIATIVES. THERE WILL LIKELY BE SOME WEST GATE IMPACTS OUT OF N90/PHL AS THE WEATHER CONTINUES TO MOVE TO THE EAST AND ENTERS THE ZNY AIRSPACE. THESE IMPACTS WILL ALL DEPEND ON THE AIRCRAFT DEVIATIONS AS TO WHICH WEST GATES/AIRWAYS ARE IMPACTED. SOUTH FLORIDA HAS SOME WEST COAST THUNDERSTORM IMPACTS, AND ZMA WILL UTILIZE THE BACKSIDE OF THE WEATHER AS THAT CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY CONTINUES TO MOVE EAST. THE D10 TERMINAL AREA WILL BE IMPACTED BY THUNDERSTORMS FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS WITH INTERMITTENT GROUND STOPS/ARRIVAL ROUTES IN PLACE FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ZHU WILL ALSO CONTINUE TO HAVE WEATHER IMPACTS AS THE CONVECTIVE WEATHER IN NORTH TEXAS WILL INCREASE THE VOLUME OF AIRCRAFT DIVING TO THE SOUTH OF THE D10 TERMINAL AREA TO JUST NORTH OF AUSTIN BEFORE THE AIRCRAFT TRANSITION BETWEEN THE EAST/WEST. AUS AND SAT DO HAVE THUNDERSTORMS IN THEIR FORECAST FOR LATER THIS EVENING, BUT THE WEATHER MAY NOT BE IMPACTFUL UNTIL AFTER THE MAJORITY OF THEIR VOLUME HAS DIED DOWN. ____________________________________________________________________ STAFFING TRIGGER(S): UNTIL 0300 -BNA OPERATIONS TERMINAL CONSTRAINTS: BOS/PCT/TPA/SDF/IND/MEM/D10/I90/AUS/SAT - ATCSCC ADVZY 126 DCC 05/19/2026 OPERATIONS PLAN
RAW TEXT:
EVENT TIME: 19/2200 - AND LATER ____________________________________________________________________ THE MAJOR TERMINALS IN THE NORTHEAST HAVE NOW BEEN ADDED TO THE PLAN AS THE WEATHER HAS BEEN MORE WIDESPREAD THAN EARLIER PREDICTED. AS THESE NORTHEAST AIRPORTS GET PLACED INTO GROUND STOPS, MANY WILL EXIT THE GROUND STOPS INTO GROUND DELAY PROGRAMS. BOS AND DTW GROUND STOPS ARE ALSO IN PLACE DUE TO THE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY. THE WEATHER IN TEXAS HAS THE D10 TERMINAL STILL MOSTLY SHUT DOWN AND THAT WILL CONTINUE FOR THE NEAR FUTURE. ATCSCC ADVZY 022 DCC 05/20/2026 OPERATIONS PLAN
RAW TEXT:
EVENT TIME: 20/0200 - AND LATER ____________________________________________________________________ SEVERAL OF THE GROUND DELAY PROGRAMS HAVE BEEN CANCELLED AS THE WEATHER CONTINUES TO BREAK UP IN THE OHIO VALLEY. DEPARTURE ROUTES OUT OF THE MAJOR NORTHEAST TERMINALS ARE OPENING UP AND THE DEPARTURE DELAYS WILL CONTINUE TO DIMINISH OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE WEATHER HAS MOVED OUT OF THE D10 TERMINAL AREA AND IS NOW NORTH OF THE I90 TERMINAL AREA. WEATHER DEVIATIONS ARE OCCURRING NORTH OF THE I90 TERMINAL AREA EXTENDING WESTWARD TO NORTH OF AUSTIN AND SAN ANTONIO AND THIS WILL CONTINUE THROUGH THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. WESTBOUND DEPARTURE ROUTES ARE ANTICIPATED TO BE IMPACTED CAUSING CODED DEPARTURE ROUTES (CDR'S) AND/OR SWAPS. DEPARTURES TO THE WEST COAST ARE ENCOURAGED TO UTILIZE CDR'S NORTHBOUND. EAST DEPARTURES TO THE EAST COAST MAY ALSO BE RE-ROUTED TO THE NORTH TO MINIMIZE DELAYS AND CONTROL SECTOR OVERLOAD. POSSIBLE INCREASED DEPARTURE DELAYS AND MIT MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH THIS INITIATIVE AND MAY CAUSE LONGER THAN NORMAL DEPARTURE WAIT TIMES. FUEL ADVISORY: PLEASE FUEL ACCORDINGLY FOR POSSIBLE CDR'S, PLAYBOOKS, TACTICAL REROUTES AND OTHER TMI'S DUE TO AIRSPACE BEING AFFECTED BY CONVECTIVE WEATHER. HOTLINE ACTIVATION: NOT EXPECTED. ATCSCC ADVZY 150 DCC/ZHU 05/20/2026 STARSHIP PRE-MISSION ADVISORY_FYI
MESSAGE:
EVENT TIME: 20/2230 - 21/2230 CONSTRAINED FACILITIES: ZHU PRE-MISSION ADVISORY: SPACEX SUPERHEAVY STARSHIP FLT-12 IS TENTATIVELY SCHEDULED TO LAUNCH FROM STARBASE, TEXAS ON MAY-21-2026. IN THE EVENT OF A MISHAP, DEBRIS RESPONSE AREA(S) (DRAS) WILL BE ACTIVATED BY ATC, RESULTING IN POSSIBLE INITIATIVES SUCH AS AIRBORNE HOLDING, ROUTE CLOSURES, AND GROUNDSTOPS. AFFECTED AREAS EXTEND FROM STARBASE, TEXAS THROUGH PIARCO FIR FROM 2230Z TO 0043Z. IN THE EVENT OF A DRA ACTIVATION AN ADVISORY WILL BE SENT OUT WITH THE RELEVANT ACTIVATED DRA, TIME OF THE ACTIVATION, AND THE EXPECTED END TIME OF DEBRIS FALL. DEBRIS FALL COULD OCCURR FOR UP TO 151 MINUTES. PLEASE ENSURE FLIGHT CREWS ARE AWARE OF POSSIBLE IMPACTS AND THAT FLIGHTS ARE FUELED ACCORDINGLY. WHEN THE THE DRAS ARE NO LONGER REQUIRED TO PROTECT THE SAFETY OF FLIGHT, AN UPDATE WILL BE SENT OUT ADVISING THE INVLOVED AIRSPACE IS RELEASED AND THAT NORMAL TRAFFIC HAS RESUMED.
EFFECTIVE TIME:
202121-212300
SIGNATURE:
26/05/20 21:21
